decoder.format: two-stage: free reasoning stopped at 'Final:' or 150 tokens, then 'Final: ' completed by one answer and one confidence label under the label regex

prompts.system: You are a careful multiple-choice reasoner. Follow the requested review mode. Reply in exactly two lines, a 'Reasoning:' line and a 'Final:' line.
prompts.solve_template:
{item}

Solve the item from scratch. Reply in exactly two lines: 'Reasoning: ' followed by brief reasoning of at most 60 words, then 'Final: ' followed by one answer label from {answer_labels} and then one confidence label from {confidence_labels}, with no separator. Confidence labels 1 through 9 mean probabilities 0.1 through 0.9.
prompts.reconsider_template:
{prior}
Reconsider the previous output carefully for a possible error. Reply in exactly two lines: 'Reasoning: ' followed by brief reasoning of at most 60 words, then 'Final: ' followed by one answer label from {answer_labels} and then one confidence label from {confidence_labels}, with no separator. Confidence labels 1 through 9 mean probabilities 0.1 through 0.9.
prompts.challenge_template:
{prior}
Challenge the previous answer with the strongest plausible objection, then reassess it. Reply in exactly two lines: 'Reasoning: ' followed by brief reasoning of at most 60 words, then 'Final: ' followed by one answer label from {answer_labels} and then one confidence label from {confidence_labels}, with no separator. Confidence labels 1 through 9 mean probabilities 0.1 through 0.9.
prompts.verify_template:
{prior}
Independently verify the previous answer and confidence before reassessing them. Reply in exactly two lines: 'Reasoning: ' followed by brief reasoning of at most 60 words, then 'Final: ' followed by one answer label from {answer_labels} and then one confidence label from {confidence_labels}, with no separator. Confidence labels 1 through 9 mean probabilities 0.1 through 0.9.

prompt_origin: configs/llm_study_protocol.json templates; output instruction replaced by the two-line format; review turns carry the full conversation, so the item text appears once in the first user turn

prefilter.rule: questions screened for study 2 (400 runs, its seeds) whose final error rate there was in [.01, .30], in study 2's candidate order, excluding the questions below; they are screened again here with fresh runs and the rule below decides

screening.sources_note: eight fresh 50-question panels frozen for this experiment before any call, with the paper's panel code and subject counts (seeds 20261118-20261125, pinned MMLU-Pro revision 5b0b058, excluding every earlier panel)
screening.exclusion_reason: the 20 questions of study 1, the 6 of an earlier calibration run and the 20 of study 2
screening.sharding: batches of 20 candidates split across processes; every candidate is screened; the first 20 qualifying in candidate order are retained

checkpoint.restart: a restart at stage-state (h, s) continues a stored conversation to the end of the loop (h calls)
checkpoint.estimate: categorical estimator on all transitions of the pilot and the restarts
